title: release-semaphore-sample-weighting-protocol-wip
content:
Purpose and context:

- This is a working ops protocol for short-lived rollouts and small-A/B experiments where we need strict, machine-enforceable gates across teams. The goal is to reduce accidental over-exposure, make rapid abort/reduce decisions unambiguous, and let SRE/product/console teams coordinate without long meetings.

- Focus areas: semaphore token model for cross-team gating, fractional sample weighting with deterministic hashing, per-cohort sentinel metrics (latency/cost/quality), escalation playbook, and contamination-minimization for overlapping rollouts.

Quick terminology (working):
- Semaphore: a lightweight token representing permission to increase exposure for a specific rollout (feature+slice). Held by a role (tactician) and enforced by traffic router/console.
- Tactician: the designated on-call for a rollout window (rotating role; typically product + SRE buddy). Responsible for issuing / revoking semaphores.
- Sample weight: a decimal fraction in router config that determines portion of traffic; uses deterministic user-hash mapping to maintain cohort stability across restarts.
- Sentinel metric: a small set of signals that must be green for semaphore to be promoted (e.g., p95 latency delta, error-rate relative lift, quality regression on eval set).

High-level flow (one-paragraph):
1) Feature owner requests a rollout by creating JIRA-RT ticket and filling the rollout canvas (link to CONFLUENCE-9876 template).
2) Product + SRE assign a tactician pair and pre-register sentinels with thresholds.
3) Tactician issues initial semaphore at weight=0.5% (alpha seed) via Console -> Router API.
4) Automated monitoring runs (5m buckets). If sentinels pass for two consecutive windows, tactician can promote semaphore to next weight per schedule. If any sentinel trips, tactician revokes semaphore immediately and triggers rollback playbook.

Weight progression recommendations (defaults, tweak per risk):
- Seed: 0.5% for 30m (min 2 windows)
- Micro: 2% for 1h
- Small-batch: 10% for 2h
- Ramp: 25% for 6h
- Broad: 50% for 24h
Notes: adjust durations when traffic volume is low (use daily sample counts) or when the feature affects rare cohorts.

Semaphore mechanics (enforcement):
- Semaphore is a single API object in the Console. It contains: rollout-id, current-weight (string decimal), tactician id, allowed-regions (optional), allowed-model-variants (optional), expiry timestamp.
- Router reads semaphores and joins them with feature flags. No human can manually change router config except via the Console API.
- All promotions/demotions must be logged in the rollout ticket and Console audit trail.

Deterministic sample weighting implementation notes:
- Hash source: user_id if present, else device_id, else ip-truncated (privacy-safe). Use fnv1a64 + modulo distribution.
- Mapping must be stable across router instances and independent of topology changes. Store mapping rule version in the semaphore metadata.
- When two rollouts overlap, weighting is composed lexicographically by rollout start timestamp to avoid split-half anomalies. Document fallback composition rule.

Sentinel definition & telemetry wiring (minimal):
- Required sentinels (core):
  - p95 latency delta (target: < +15% relative)
  - request error rate (4xx/5xx) absolute delta (target: < +0.2pp)
  - inference model quality proxy (top-k rerank delta or eval-set mean scorer) (target: no negative regression beyond threshold)
  - cost per 1k requests (monitor cost spikes from model variant changes)
- Optional: business KPI metric (e.g., click-through for ranking features) if product owns it.
- Telemetry: monitoring dashboards must be pre-created with the exact metric names and alert windows. Use a standard 'rollout' namespace tag so queries can filter by rollout-id.

Automated decision rules (for accelerated safe ramps):
- If all core sentinels are stable for 4 consecutive windows, auto-promote up one step. Auto-promote disabled for experiments that touch billing, or legal-sensitive cohorts.
- If any sentinel exceeds critical threshold once, auto-revoke to previous safe weight and page tactician.

Escalation & rollback playbook (operational script):
1) Tactician sees sentinel breach -> revoke semaphore to last-green weight immediately via Console API.
2) Create a short incident note in the rollout ticket with metrics snapshot and assign to SRE/Product.
3) If root-cause not obvious within 30m, escalate to oncall (pager). If regression impacts customer-facing errors, file higher-severity incident and inform CX.
4) After rollback, run controlled diagnostic sweep (A/B off on 100% sample but with synthetic traffic) to reproduce.

Contamination and overlapping rollouts guidance:
- Always annotate rollouts with expected overlapping rollouts (field in ticket).
- When two rollouts could touch same decision path, require a cross-rollout preflight step (cross-check cohorts and sample hashing).
- If collision detected, freeze both semaphores and run coordinated test window with mirrored synthetic traffic.

Experiment validity and power checks (practical):
- Before micro-A/B, compute expected daily unique active user (DAU) in target slice; if DAU < 10k, extend window or increase weight to reach sample power.
- Provide a one-click power calc in the rollout canvas: inputs = baseline conversion, min detectable lift, allocation ratio, horizon. Output = sample estimate and suggested ramp plan.

Runbook checklist (pre-rollout, must be green):
- [ ] Rollout ticket created + rollout-canvas completed (link)
- [ ] Tactician assigned and availability window set
- [ ] Sentinel metrics and thresholds documented in ticket
- [ ] Dashboards + alert rules created and previewed by SRE
- [ ] Router config test plan (local canary) executed in staging
- [ ] Privacy & legal flags checked (PII handling by feature)
- [ ] Failover model variants (lower-cost / small-seq) registered for fallback

Open questions / TODOs (for the working group):
- Define exact set of 'core' sentinels for multimodal features (chat vs embeddings vs rerank).
- Decide retention window length for rollout audit logs (30d vs 90d).
- Harmonize deterministic hashing across mobile SDKs and browser clients (current discrepancy: mobile uses murmur, server uses fnv).
- How to integrate Dedicated/Private deployments where Console cannot directly change router? (proposal: semaphore intent via signed ticket + ops runbook).

Notes-to-self / quick action items for next week:
- Collect a sample of 6 recent rollouts and tabulate time-to-detect regressions + escalation cadence (ask Miguel to pull the logs).
- Prototype the one-click power calc widget in the rollout canvas (Jun to spin up a PR).
- Draft short training slide (10m) for tactician rotation runbook.

References and links:
- CONFLUENCE-9876 (rollout canvas template)
- JIRA-RT-314 (router-semaphore epic)
- github PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/traffic-router/pull/128

End of draft. Keep this lean — this doc is meant to be the ops cheat-sheet + canonical enforcement model. Expect follow-ups from SRE and Product with concrete sentinel thresholds next sprint.
